kashika: तद्धितान्तः शब्दोऽसर्वविभक्तिरव्ययसंज्ञो भवति। यस्माद् न सर्वविभक्तेरुत्पत्तिः सोऽसर्वविभक्तिः। ततः। यतः। तत्र। यत्र। तदा। यदा। सर्वदा। सदा। तद्धित इति किम्? एकः। द्वौ। बहवः। असर्वविभक्तिरिति किम्? औपगवः, औपगवौ, औपगवाः॥
kashikaEnglish: A taddhita derivative that cannot take all case endings is an indeclinable.
englishShort: A तद्धितान्त word to which all the विभक्तिप्रत्ययाः cannot be attached is known as 'अव्यय'.
englishFull:
Words formed by तद्धित (secondary) affixes that do not take all case endings are also अव्यय.

तद्धित affixes derive nouns from other nouns. When such derivatives take only certain cases (not all seven), they are indeclinable.

**Examples:**
- ततः "thence" — ablative only (from तद्)
- तत्र "there" — locative only
- यतः "whence," यत्र "where"
- तदा "then," यदा "when," सर्वदा "always"
